subject: prd/plan-new
statement: When a plan is assembled, the planner shall check coverage against the plan's in-scope slice, mapping every slice requirement to at least one task and every task to at least one requirement or design anchor; prior-plan coverage is not re-demanded, while feature-level Must completeness is the union across the feature's plans and a live Must in no slice is a named defect.
rationale: plan slices avoid re-planning shipped work without dropping feature-level Musts
fit_criterion: amendment-slice, frozen-base, missing-live-Must, dropped-slice, and rogue-task fixtures produce the specified result
